_comment: Curated purposes only. Paths must exist and every key file's symbol must be found in that file, or project_map raises and the tests fail. Line numbers are looked up live, never stored here.

areas.purpose: Application core: main loop, sequencer, MIDI, project structs, themes, profiler.

key_files.why: Audio interrupt entry: runs midiUpdate(), sequencer.tick() and the audio engine every block.
Main loop: display, file manager and UI updates.
Sequencer clock, called from the audio interrupt.
MIDI input handling, called from the audio interrupt.
Serialized instrument struct; its size is a static_assert'ed contract.
Audio block load measurement for performance work.

areas.purpose: Per-voice playback engine, audio sequencer FX, SD streaming of long samples, master FX.

key_files.why: Engine update called each audio block.
Hybrid SD streaming of samples >= 256 KB.

areas.purpose: Teensy-derived audio graph (AudioStream blocks): sample players, filters, envelopes, mixers, limiter, reverb.

key_files.why: Block allocation and routing every audio class builds on.
Sample playback, dispatched per play mode.
Master limiter; covered by tests/audio golden hashes.
Per-voice state-variable filter; covered by tests/audio golden hashes.

areas.purpose: Display widget library on the FT812 graphics chip: controls, refresh queue, 8,172-byte frame budget.

key_files.why: Display state machine run from the main loop.
Base class of every on-screen control.
Style bits shared by all controls (nearly exhausted).

areas.purpose: FT812 command wrappers (API_* functions) shared by both platforms.

key_files.why: How control display lists are stitched into each frame.

areas.purpose: UI screens (modules): one directory per screen, g*.cpp draws, f*.cpp handles input. Recipe: ui-screen.

key_files.why: The table of screens; slot numbers used throughout the UI.
Screen names in the Tracker Mini module menu and Fn key bindings.

areas.purpose: Projects, patterns, instruments and samples on the SD card: load, save, copy-on-write workspace, import, export.

key_files.why: Chunked sample loading; SD alignment matters here.
Workspace project load state machine (one step per main-loop pass).

areas.purpose: Sample Editor effects, including the .ptfx plugin loader.

key_files.why: Binary plugin parameter descriptor (32 bytes).

areas.purpose: Synth glue for Tracker+ and Mini: engine registry, the Synth wrapper, open-source engines. Recipe: synth-engine.

key_files.why: Where synth engines are registered.
The Model menu order; indexes the UI name and badge tables.
The open engine contract (all three devices). Recipe: open-synth-engine.
Where open engines are registered.

areas.purpose: Public PolySynth headers and the Open Synth SDK; the engine implementations themselves are precompiled in synth/lib.

key_files.why: Serialized engine ids: append only.
Base class for open-source engines.
Parameter metadata (range, curve, formatter) the UI reads.

areas.purpose: Original Tracker (Kinetis MK66, Cortex-M4F 180 MHz): drivers, startup, linker script.

key_files.why: Display transport for MK66.

areas.purpose: Tracker+ and Tracker Mini (i.MX RT, Cortex-M7 600 MHz): NXP SDK drivers, USB, SD, linker scripts.

key_files.why: Display transport for IMX.
Where AUDIO_CORE_RAM code is placed (ITCM).

areas.purpose: MIT-licensed SDK and builder for .ptfx Sample Editor plugins, with reference effects.

key_files.why: Packs plugin sources into .ptfx files.

areas.purpose: User guides and developer documentation (top-level *.md is synced to the GitHub wiki).

key_files.why: Memory regions, budgets and platform guards.
